handback.title: The card follows the repo's own CI
handback.summary: The card redraws when the repo's own CI finishes, and shows every check the merge needs.
handback.user_story: The owner sees the repo's own checks on the card, current as soon as their CI finishes.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the repo's own CI finishes on a pull request, its issue's card redraws.
acceptance_criteria.words: The card redraws only when Dokima's own workflows finish, not when the adopter's CI does.

edge_cases.case: The repo's CI has a name no one could guess: the card still redraws.
The repo's CI run ends in failure: the card still redraws.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the branch rule requires a check, the card shows that check, the repo's own included, with its state.
acceptance_criteria.words: The merge gate already waits on every required check; the card must show them.

edge_cases.case: A required check of the repo's own passed: it shows as passed.
A required check has not run yet: it shows as not started.
The repo's CI reports a required check as a commit status: it shows its state.

answers.why: Both redraw tests now also play a CI with an unguessable name; listening for known names fails.
